name: courier-vscode
description: Courier Studio in your editor: above each call to an endpoint, how its calls went — how many, how many failed, how long they took — and the call opens in Studio.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Courier starts Studio, create-courier and the project's MCP servers from the project's folder, and sends Studio the text of the files you open: a workspace you have not trusted gets none of it.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Courier finds Studio through the address file a running Studio writes to the project's folder on disk.

courier.hints.enabled.description: Show above each call to an endpoint how its calls went in Courier Studio.

courier.hints.refreshSeconds.description: How often the hints are brought up to date while the window has focus, in seconds.

courier.studio.url.markdownDescription: Courier Studio's address, when it runs for a project outside this workspace: `http://localhost:6280`. Left empty, the extension finds the Studio each project in the workspace runs. Only an address on this machine is used — the extension sends Studio the text of the files you open — and only from your user settings, never a workspace's.
